review.notes: Full review. Gate passes at the head; depcheck 0 problems (261 roadmaps, 2526 edges). Findings: R01 P2 (10.7 lower-tower constancy has no route and no supplier input; GS leaves the case to the reader), R02 P3 (3.8 Needs omits ExceptionalThetaCorrespondencesForG2 Layer 1), R03 P3 (vacuous Checks in 6.6-6.7: S_phi is elementary abelian on diamond parameters). 27 declared gaps match plan.json and README, all with suppliers. Overlap with the closest roadmaps: no doubly owned object. Wording and arrangement independent of GS (111 of 179 locators).
